panels.figure_caption: The CT scan images illustrate key radiologic features of silicosis: Mediastinal lymphadenopathy with eggshell calcifications, a hallmark of silicosis, is visible (orange arrows in figures A, B, and C). A fibrotic calcified mass in the right upper lobe is prominent (green arrows in figures A, B, and D). Calcified nodules and micronodules distributed randomly across the lung fields are highlighted (blue arrows in figures A, B, C and D). These findings together confirm the diagnosis of silicosis and demonstrate its mixed presentation, including fibrosis, emphysema, and calcifications.
